title: Coefficient section with prescribed p-basis lifts
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a nonzero complete Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring] of characteristic $p>0$, with residue field $k=A/\mathfrak m$. Let $(b_i)_{i\in E}$ be a $p$-basis of $k$, meaning that the finitely supported monomials $\prod_i b_i^{n_i}$, $0\leq n_i<p$, form a vector-space basis of $k$ over $k^p=\{x^p:x\in k\}$. For each $i$ choose any lift $\beta_i\in A$ of $b_i$. There is a unique field homomorphism $s:k\to A$ whose composite with the residue map is the identity and such that $s(b_i)=\beta_i$ for every $i$.

source.place: Expose IV 2.1.4, printed p.50: unique coefficient field containing arbitrary lifts of a residue-field p-basis (there attributed to Bourbaki, Algebre commutative IX, section 2, no.2, Theorem 1(a)).
